sections.effect_symptoms_of_female_irregularities:
Menstrual disorder can cause multiple Physical and Emotional effect on women health 

 Physical effects such as sleep disturbance like poor sleep quality, difficulty in staying awake or alert during daytime, longer or shorter sleeps. 
 Behavioral or emotional effects such as irritability, mood swings, depression, increased appetite, dejection, hypersensitivity. 

 Around one-third of the women show neuroticism and emotional instability as well. Sometimes PMS also causes abnormal functioning of the central neurotransmitter. Lack of awareness and clarity, non-acceptance, limited emotional responses and difficulty in controlling negative impulses are some of the other symptoms of menstrual irregularities. Although, only approx. 5% of women express significant symptoms of PMS.
sections.reasons_causes:
Sleep disorders cause progesterone dependent resistance to hypothermic effects of melatonin during luteal phase. Impaired secretion of estrogen and progesterone affects the neural mechanism in sleep and awake regions in the brain. Also the inverse relationship between progesterone and prostaglandins has a negative influence on sleep cycles. 
 Neurotransmitter Serotonin plays a major role in controlling mood and anxiety. Estrogen influences the functioning of many neurotransmitters such as serotonin, dopamine, acetylcholine and noradrenaline. During the luteal phase there is a decrease in the level of estrogen which leads to development of PMS symptoms. It also decreases the activity of monoamine oxidase A and B enzymes in the brain region. Both serotonin and estrogen work together in brain regions associated with mood regulations. Estrogen-progesterone imbalance causes mood swings and emotional instability in women.
sections.diagnosis: Early diagnosis of PMS is crucial. Some of the menstrual disorders can be diagnosed through Ultrasound, endometrial biopsy and sonohysterography. But if you are observing the symptoms given above consult your doctor for further diagnosis.
